notes: This is reconstructed DUAL-01, not exact legacy Stage19/RH-50 parity.
Previous runtime predictions and working code were unavailable; all first-stage fits were rebuilt and atomically saved.
18 missing signal months reflect European coverage/as-of calendar constraints; both markets use the same retained months and carry positions in missing months.
Multi-horizon targets improve both markets relative to a matched mature-63 training control, but do not beat the full baseline in both markets in the main development period.
The predeclared annual router worsens development return and drawdown in both markets; it was not retuned.
Conditional NIW probabilities concern uncertain mean effects, not future winning probabilities, and are not corrected for selection across all historical tests.
Price adjustments, distributions, survivor selection and realistic execution remain uncertified.
No automatic rejection was based on a confidence interval containing zero.
Complete tables, curves, ledgers, prepared data and prediction checkpoints are retained in downloadable archives; not all binary inputs are uploaded to this branch.
